items.briefing:
Microsoft has released its largest-ever monthly security update, patching close to 1,000 vulnerabilities in its products. Two of these flaws are already being actively exploited by attackers, meaning cybercriminals are using them right now. If your organisation uses any Microsoft software — which most do — it's important that IT staff apply these updates as soon as possible.

Separately, UNSW Sydney has launched ChatGPT Edu for its 80,000-strong community, a reminder that AI tools are becoming part of everyday work and study across Australian organisations.

**Tip:** Check with your IT team today to confirm Microsoft's latest security updates have been applied to your devices.

featured.title: Rapid7 highlights two exploited flaws in September Patch Tuesday
